run_random_search: run a random search on an LLVM environment using parallel RandomAgentWorker threads
run_eval_llvm_instcount_policy: run the eval_llvm_instcount_policy function with the random_search policy on the LLVM benchmark
create_random_agent_worker: create a RandomAgentWorker with a make_env lambda and patience parameter for parallel search
define_patience_ratio_flag: define the patience_ratio flag to control patience as a ratio of the action space size
define_search_time_flag: define the search_time flag to set the minimum seconds to run the random search
